read.thesis: Q4 CY25 revenue up 6.7% to $19.5bn and Adjusted EBITDA up 10.8%; 2026 guide implies Adjusted EBITDA $15.55–16.45bn and capex $5.0–5.5bn, with no supply-side capacity cut signalled.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures for 2026, excluding acquisitions, are estimated to range between $5.0 billion and $5.5 billion.

guidance.quote: estimated to range between $5.0 billion and $5.5 billion

triggers.label: Same facility revenue per equivalent admission +2.9%
triggers.quote: Same facility revenue per equivalent admission increased 2.9 percent

triggers.label: Outpatient surgeries down 0.5%
